description: NaCaMg₂F₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with six MgF₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.64 Å. Ca is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with six MgF₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.56 Å. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six F atoms to form MgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-50°. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.01 Å) Mg-F bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six F atoms to form MgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-48°. All Mg-F bond lengths are 2.01 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Mg atoms to form distorted FCa₂Mg₂ tetrahedra that share corners with six FCa₂Mg₂ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Mg atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ca atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra.
